strategy: Technology Leadership + AI/Cloud Transformation + Telecom/Enterprise + Strategic Customer + Strategy-to-Execution
principles: Prioritize gaps that recur across target roles and can improve screening evidence within 30-90 days.
Do not try to retrofit structural history such as years in a major consulting firm; use positioning and selective role targeting instead.
Do not infer causality from a single rejection; require multiple comparable outcomes before recalibrating role families.
Never invent metrics. Reconstruct only figures that can be defended in interview or supported by records.

market_evidence: Telefónica Account Executive Grandes Clientes explicitly manages targets based on revenue, new sales and customer satisfaction.
AWS Customer Solutions Manager requires business cases, measurable customer benefits, efficiency gains, cost savings or growth.
priority_gaps.action_today: Reconstruct Nokia/Telefónica evidence: account scope, contract/revenue ranges, portfolio size, number/type of strategic customers, proposal/RFP wins, teams coordinated and measurable customer outcomes. Mark every figure as confirmed, defensible range or unknown.
priority_gaps.target_evidence: A one-page quantified achievements inventory reusable in CV, LinkedIn and interviews.
priority_gaps.selection_probability_effect: Not numerically assigned yet; expected to strengthen screening and interview credibility across commercial and transformation roles, but current outcome data are insufficient for a defensible point estimate.

priority_gaps.gap: Formal cloud/AI credentials aligned with hyperscaler roles
market_evidence: AWS Customer Solutions Manager lists AWS or other cloud certification as preferred.
Telefónica Account Specialist Cloud values VMware, Azure, GCP and AWS architecture/security/network certifications.
Capgemini Cloud Solution Architect lists AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Terraform Associate and Kubernetes certification as must-to-have for that technical role.
plan: P0: Google Cloud Generative AI Leader
Kubernetes practical evidence before pursuing certification unless role frequency justifies it
priority_gaps.action_today: Confirm baseline readiness for Google Cloud Generative AI Leader and complete the next official learning-path activity; record actual progress rather than estimating it.
priority_gaps.selection_probability_effect: No numeric uplift assigned until application outcomes provide enough comparable evidence; certification is repeatedly preferred/valued in current market evidence.

priority_gaps.gap: Formal major-consulting tenure and consulting revenue track record for senior strategy roles
market_evidence: Accenture GCC Strategy & Transformation Senior Manager asks for 8-12 years in consulting.
Capgemini Invent AI Strategist asks for a strategic consulting background and commercial contribution, including approximately GBP1m consulting revenue at senior levels.
priority_gaps.action_today: Do not spend training time trying to simulate historical consulting tenure. Reframe verified independent advisory/technology transformation work as consulting evidence, quantify business-development outcomes where defensible, and deprioritize roles where major-firm consulting tenure is an explicit knockout criterion.
priority_gaps.selection_probability_effect: Structural constraint; improved narrative can reduce ambiguity but cannot replace explicit years-of-consulting requirements.

next_tier.gap: Hands-on Python/APIs/GenAI and agentic production evidence
next_tier.action: Publish a deployed enterprise GenAI/API project with architecture, evaluation, observability, cost and Responsible AI evidence.
TOGAF Foundation + Practitioner after cloud P0/P1 milestones.
Docker -> Kubernetes -> GKE/EKS deployment evidence; pursue certification only if target-role frequency rises.

outcome_calibration.note: Accenture Principal Agentic AI Transformation Lead - Hands On was rejected pre-interview. This remains a weak calibration signal for very hands-on Principal Agentic AI roles only and is insufficient to infer a general AI-market pattern.
